units.displayText: I will cleanse you, and then reset myself before the Daemonic corruption overtakes me...

spans.text: I will cleanse you, and then reset myself before the Daemonic corruption overtakes me...

units.rawText: Her movements seem to have slowed down. I avoid her attack, but I feel dizzier and dizzier, as though I'll collapse at any moment.
units.displayText: Her movements seem to have slowed down. I avoid her attack, but I feel dizzier and dizzier, as though I'll collapse at any moment.

spans.text: Her movements seem to have slowed down. I avoid her attack, but I feel dizzier and dizzier, as though I'll collapse at any moment.

units.rawText: It feels like I'm being pierced by needles from head to toe. It hurts so much I can't bear it.
units.displayText: It feels like I'm being pierced by needles from head to toe. It hurts so much I can't bear it.

spans.text: It feels like I'm being pierced by needles from head to toe. It hurts so much I can't bear it.

units.rawText: Mayuri!
units.displayText: Mayuri!

spans.text: Mayuri!

units.rawText: Just then, Kurisu-chan shows up. The knife in front of me is knocked away, and then someone grabs my hand.
units.displayText: Just then, Kurisu-chan shows up. The knife in front of me is knocked away, and then someone grabs my hand.

spans.text: Just then, Kurisu-chan shows up. The knife in front of me is knocked away, and then someone grabs my hand.

units.rawText: <size=40>Mayuri, RUN!</size>
units.displayText: Mayuri, RUN!

spans.text: Mayuri, RUN!

units.rawText: <size=40>Kurisu-chan!</size>
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan!

spans.text: Kurisu-chan!

units.rawText: The sight of Kurisu-chan makes me want to cry.
units.displayText: The sight of Kurisu-chan makes me want to cry.

spans.text: The sight of Kurisu-chan makes me want to cry.

units.rawText: I bite back the pain and frantically run along with Kurisu-chan.
units.displayText: I bite back the pain and frantically run along with Kurisu-chan.

spans.text: I bite back the pain and frantically run along with Kurisu-chan.

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan, what are you doing here?
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan, what are you doing here?

spans.text: Kurisu-chan, what are you doing here?

units.rawText: I heard what sounded like your voice, and so...
units.displayText: I heard what sounded like your voice, and so...

spans.text: I heard what sounded like your voice, and so...

units.rawText: But before I could meet up with you, these guys started chasing you...
units.displayText: But before I could meet up with you, these guys started chasing you...

spans.text: But before I could meet up with you, these guys started chasing you...

units.rawText: At long last, we managed to meet up...
units.displayText: At long last, we managed to meet up...

spans.text: At long last, we managed to meet up...

units.rawText: Wait... (pants) Don't run... so fast...
units.displayText: Wait... (pants) Don't run... so fast...

spans.text: Wait... (pants) Don't run... so fast...

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan... We need to escape!
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan... We need to escape!

spans.text: Kurisu-chan... We need to escape!

units.rawText: I hold Kurisu-chan's hand tightly, feeling a little bit of courage inside me.
units.displayText: I hold Kurisu-chan's hand tightly, feeling a little bit of courage inside me.

spans.text: I hold Kurisu-chan's hand tightly, feeling a little bit of courage inside me.

units.rawText: My dizziness and the pain in the rest of my body doesn't matter. The robots and whoever don't matter.
units.displayText: My dizziness and the pain in the rest of my body doesn't matter. The robots and whoever don't matter.

spans.text: My dizziness and the pain in the rest of my body doesn't matter. The robots and whoever don't matter.

units.rawText: That's right! There's two of us now, so we'll definitely be able to escape! No matter what problems we encounter—
units.displayText: That's right! There's two of us now, so we'll definitely be able to escape! No matter what problems we encounter—

spans.text: That's right! There's two of us now, so we'll definitely be able to escape! No matter what problems we encounter—

units.rawText: As I think this, I look back toward that robot girl even as I run with Kurisu-chan.
units.displayText: As I think this, I look back toward that robot girl even as I run with Kurisu-chan.

spans.text: As I think this, I look back toward that robot girl even as I run with Kurisu-chan.

units.rawText: Her eyes seem to have changed color, and in the next moment, a gun appears in her hand as though by magic.
units.displayText: Her eyes seem to have changed color, and in the next moment, a gun appears in her hand as though by magic.

spans.text: Her eyes seem to have changed color, and in the next moment, a gun appears in her hand as though by magic.

units.rawText: <size=40>Don't—</size>
units.displayText: Don't—

spans.text: Don't—

units.rawText: Bang!
units.displayText: Bang!

spans.text: Bang!

units.rawText: There is a gunshot, and then the hand I'm holding suddenly becomes very heavy.
units.displayText: There is a gunshot, and then the hand I'm holding suddenly becomes very heavy.

spans.text: There is a gunshot, and then the hand I'm holding suddenly becomes very heavy.

units.rawText: Hot liquid splashes on my face and a look of pain crosses Kurisu's face.
units.displayText: Hot liquid splashes on my face and a look of pain crosses Kurisu's face.

spans.text: Hot liquid splashes on my face and a look of pain crosses Kurisu's face.

units.rawText: Eh...
units.displayText: Eh...

spans.text: Eh...

units.rawText: What... just happened...?
units.displayText: What... just happened...?

spans.text: What... just happened...?

units.rawText: Run... away...
units.displayText: Run... away...

spans.text: Run... away...

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan lets go of my hand and murmurs those words before she falls.
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan lets go of my hand and murmurs those words before she falls.

spans.text: Kurisu-chan lets go of my hand and murmurs those words before she falls.

units.rawText: <size=40>Kurisu-chan!</size>
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan!

spans.text: Kurisu-chan!

units.rawText: Wake up! Kurisu-chan!
units.displayText: Wake up! Kurisu-chan!

spans.text: Wake up! Kurisu-chan!

units.rawText: The light slowly fades from Kurisu-chan's eyes.
units.displayText: The light slowly fades from Kurisu-chan's eyes.

spans.text: The light slowly fades from Kurisu-chan's eyes.

units.rawText: Is Kurisu-chan... dead..?
units.displayText: Is Kurisu-chan... dead..?

spans.text: Is Kurisu-chan... dead..?

units.rawText: No, it can't be. This can't be right.
units.displayText: No, it can't be. This can't be right.

spans.text: No, it can't be. This can't be right.

units.rawText: I'm dreaming, right? How could this be real?!
units.displayText: I'm dreaming, right? How could this be real?!

spans.text: I'm dreaming, right? How could this be real?!

units.rawText: This has to be fake. The real Mayushii should be sleeping in the lab right now.
units.displayText: This has to be fake. The real Mayushii should be sleeping in the lab right now.

spans.text: This has to be fake. The real Mayushii should be sleeping in the lab right now.

units.rawText: The party's about to start, so I need to wake up! Someone, anyone, please wake Mayushii up.
units.displayText: The party's about to start, so I need to wake up! Someone, anyone, please wake Mayushii up.

spans.text: The party's about to start, so I need to wake up! Someone, anyone, please wake Mayushii up.

units.rawText: Elimination of one Irregular Agent confirmed. Second Irregular Agent has ceased movement.
units.displayText: Elimination of one Irregular Agent confirmed. Second Irregular Agent has ceased movement.

spans.text: Elimination of one Irregular Agent confirmed. Second Irregular Agent has ceased movement.

units.rawText: Maintain distance and ensure termination of high-threat Daemon.
units.displayText: Maintain distance and ensure termination of high-threat Daemon.

spans.text: Maintain distance and ensure termination of high-threat Daemon.

units.rawText: There is another "bang" and a stabbing pain pierces my calf. I collapse to the ground, beside Kurisu-chan.
units.displayText: There is another "bang" and a stabbing pain pierces my calf. I collapse to the ground, beside Kurisu-chan.

spans.text: There is another "bang" and a stabbing pain pierces my calf. I collapse to the ground, beside Kurisu-chan.

units.rawText: ...This isn't a dream.
units.displayText: ...This isn't a dream.

spans.text: ...This isn't a dream.

units.rawText: This scene which seems so totally unreal is, in fact, reality.
units.displayText: This scene which seems so totally unreal is, in fact, reality.

spans.text: This scene which seems so totally unreal is, in fact, reality.

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan, Kurisu-chan...
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan, Kurisu-chan...

spans.text: Kurisu-chan, Kurisu-chan...

units.rawText: I do my best to get up, trying to help Kurisu-chan up so we can escape together. But her body feels like it's gone totally limp and won't get up.
units.displayText: I do my best to get up, trying to help Kurisu-chan up so we can escape together. But her body feels like it's gone totally limp and won't get up.

spans.text: I do my best to get up, trying to help Kurisu-chan up so we can escape together. But her body feels like it's gone totally limp and won't get up.

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan... Please get up... Please run...
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan... Please get up... Please run...

spans.text: Kurisu-chan... Please get up... Please run...

units.rawText: Ma... Mayu...
units.displayText: Ma... Mayu...

spans.text: Ma... Mayu...

units.rawText: Red liquid spreads across the ground and Kurisu-chan's eyes go dark.
units.displayText: Red liquid spreads across the ground and Kurisu-chan's eyes go dark.

spans.text: Red liquid spreads across the ground and Kurisu-chan's eyes go dark.

units.rawText: This is wrong. This is wrong. This is wrong.
units.displayText: This is wrong. This is wrong. This is wrong.

spans.text: This is wrong. This is wrong. This is wrong.

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan's not dead.
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan's not dead.

spans.text: Kurisu-chan's not dead.

units.rawText: I'm sure there'll be a way to save Kurisu-chan when I meet Okarin and the others.
units.displayText: I'm sure there'll be a way to save Kurisu-chan when I meet Okarin and the others.

spans.text: I'm sure there'll be a way to save Kurisu-chan when I meet Okarin and the others.

units.rawText: If I can bring her back to the Lab, she'll be fine.
units.displayText: If I can bring her back to the Lab, she'll be fine.

spans.text: If I can bring her back to the Lab, she'll be fine.

units.rawText: I carefully pick up Kurisu-chan. Her body feels very light.
units.displayText: I carefully pick up Kurisu-chan. Her body feels very light.

spans.text: I carefully pick up Kurisu-chan. Her body feels very light.

units.rawText: I start to run with all my might.
units.displayText: I start to run with all my might.

spans.text: I start to run with all my might.

units.rawText: Something seems to hit me, but I can still move.
units.displayText: Something seems to hit me, but I can still move.

spans.text: Something seems to hit me, but I can still move.

units.rawText: It hurts all over, but I feel like I've got endless strength. I should be able to bring Kurisu-chan back like this.
units.displayText: It hurts all over, but I feel like I've got endless strength. I should be able to bring Kurisu-chan back like this.

spans.text: It hurts all over, but I feel like I've got endless strength. I should be able to bring Kurisu-chan back like this.

units.rawText: Just hang in there, Kurisu-chan...
units.displayText: Just hang in there, Kurisu-chan...

spans.text: Just hang in there, Kurisu-chan...

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan doesn't answer me.
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan doesn't answer me.

spans.text: Kurisu-chan doesn't answer me.

units.rawText: Everything will be all right, you'll be okay...
units.displayText: Everything will be all right, you'll be okay...
